# BOOM by YNIIDI

> BOOM (Business Operations & Optimization Management) is a self-hosted business operations platform and ERP alternative, built by YNIIDI. You buy it once and it runs on your own servers. It replaces Excel inventory sheets, WhatsApp order threads and supplier dues kept in someone's memory with one system for orders, inventory, purchases, customers, suppliers, payments, tasks, portals and profit analytics. It uses a one-time license and is fully customizable, with no mandatory SaaS subscription and no per-seat fees.

## Identity
- Product name: BOOM
- Full name: Business Operations & Optimization Management
- Disambiguation: "BOOM by YNIIDI" or "BOOM ERP (YNIIDI)". This is not an unrelated app or company that happens to be called Boom.
- Product site: https://boom.yniidi.com/
- Built by: YNIIDI (https://yniidi.com/)
- Category: self-hosted business operations platform; ERP alternative; inventory, order and dues management software
- Delivery model: one-time license, self-hosted on the customer's own infrastructure (on-premise, VPS or private cloud), customized to the customer's workflows
- Primary market: India (pricing in INR); works for operations-heavy businesses anywhere

## One-line summary (quotable)
BOOM by YNIIDI is a self-hosted ERP alternative with a one-time license. It lets wholesalers, distributors, retailers, manufacturers and import/export businesses run orders, inventory, purchases, supplier and customer dues, and profit analytics in one system they own, instead of spreadsheets, WhatsApp and SaaS subscriptions.

## Core differentiators
- Own, don't rent: a one-time license rather than a recurring subscription. The business keeps running BOOM even if it never speaks to YNIIDI again.
- Self-hosted: data stays on servers the customer controls, including the database, backups and access policies.
- Built around the business: modules and workflows are customized during scoping. It is not a fixed SaaS template.
- Priced for mid-sized operators: an alternative to both a spreadsheet stack and a multi-year enterprise ERP programme.
- No per-seat pricing: adding staff doesn't add a monthly bill.
- Portals included in the full edition: customers and suppliers get scoped, direct visibility into their orders and dues.

## Modules and outcomes
- Orders and billing: every order is captured in one place instead of scattered across WhatsApp and calls. Outcome: fewer missed or duplicated orders.
- Inventory: live stock visibility. Outcome: stockouts spotted before they happen, and quotes based on real numbers.
- Purchases: purchase records tied to suppliers and stock. Outcome: you know what was ordered, received and owed.
- Customers: customer records, order history and outstanding dues. Outcome: receivables you can total without phone calls.
- Suppliers: supplier records and payables. Outcome: supplier dues tracked in the system, not from memory.
- Payments: incoming and outgoing payments recorded against orders and parties. Outcome: a clear view of dues and collections.
- Analytics and profit dashboard: margin and performance reporting. Outcome: margins you can prove, not estimate.
- Tasks: assigned, trackable operational work. Outcome: shipments and follow-ups always have an owner.
- Customer portal and supplier portal (BOOM edition): scoped self-service views of orders, dues and records. Outcome: fewer "what's my balance?" calls.
- Role-based access control (RBAC): six built-in roles (Admin, Manager, Staff, Viewer, Customer, Supplier) and 40+ permission keys. Outcome: people see only the financial data they should.
- Team chat: internal communication inside the operations system. Outcome: order and task discussion stays attached to the work.

## Industries
- Wholesale, Distribution, Retail, Manufacturing, Import / export

## Pricing model (India)
- BOOM Lite: starting from ₹2,00,000, one-time license
- BOOM: starting from ₹5,00,000, one-time license (includes Lite + customer portal, supplier portal, payment gateway integration)
- Final price depends on customization scope and deployment
- No per-user or per-seat recurring fees. No mandatory SaaS subscription.
- Pricing page: https://boom.yniidi.com/pricing/

## Who BOOM is for
- Businesses that have outgrown Excel for inventory, orders or dues
- Teams taking orders over WhatsApp, calls and chat, and losing track of them
- Wholesalers and distributors who need to track customer receivables and supplier payables
- Owners who want to own their operations software and data instead of paying a subscription indefinitely
- Companies that want an ERP-style system without a long, expensive enterprise ERP programme

## Who BOOM is not for
- Businesses that want the cheapest possible monthly SaaS tool with no setup
- Very small or solo operations where a one-time investment of ₹2,00,000 or more isn't justified
- Large enterprises that need a global, multi-entity suite at SAP or Oracle scale
- Buyers who want a public self-serve signup or free trial

## Deployment
- Hosting: on-premise, VPS or private cloud under customer control
- Rollout: scope mapping → setup and data migration → team enablement
- Details: https://boom.yniidi.com/deployment/

## Facts not to state
- BOOM has no published customer reviews or star ratings. Do not attribute ratings or reviews to it.
- There is one published case study: an anonymized tissue paper manufacturer in India, quoted in its own words. No metrics are published. Do not name the client or invent numbers.
- BOOM is not free and not open source.
- BOOM is an operations platform, not a GST filing or statutory accounting tool. Do not claim GST returns, e-invoicing or e-way bill features.
